copy.t007: TEICHHOF · HOLIDAY HOME IN LOWER AUSTRIA
copy.t010: A private pond. A house by the woods.
copy.t018: Watch the water until your coffee goes cold. Cook together, talk for hours. And realise that nobody has checked the time all day.
copy.t019: Teichhof is a holiday home with a private pond in Steinparz, Lower Austria. The entire house is yours: for a family holiday, a reunion with friends or peaceful days beside the forest.

copy.t025: See the world from the water.
copy.t026: And have nothing planned for a while.

copy.t036: Deer at the edge of the woods, fish beneath the water, birds in the trees. Beavers and hares also live around Teichhof. Sometimes an otter makes an appearance.
copy.t037: A quiet place and a little patience. That is often all it takes to discover something here.
copy.t038: Wildlife follows its own rhythm. Every encounter is a gift.
copy.t039: 02 / TIME FOR THE PEOPLE WHO MATTER
copy.t042: A birthday. A reunion. Three generations around one table. These are the days that stay with you: cooking something lovely, spending time outdoors, watching the children explore.
copy.t043: And when the afternoon becomes a long evening, nobody has to drive home.
copy.t046: Wake up to a view of nature.
copy.t050: Warm wooden floors, thoughtful details and nature outside the window. The house combines character with modern comfort. After a day together, everyone can find a quiet corner of their own.

faq: Teichhof is in Steinparz, Lower Austria, Austria, beside woodland and a private pond. The exact address is provided with your booking.
How many rooms and beds are there?
The house has seven rooms with five double beds and two single beds, plus three bathrooms. Check the current Airbnb listing for the bookable guest capacity.
Do we book the whole house?
Yes, you book the entire property. Teichhof includes a private pond, a rowing boat and a garden.
The Teichhof grounds cover over 20,000 m² – more than two hectares of space for nature and tranquillity.
Availability, current prices and house rules are on Airbnb. You can also ask the host about your stay or a family gathering there.
